THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner is absent.
The matter is listed for sixth time for compliance of office objections.
The order sheet dated 10.01.2023 reads as under.

"Though the matter is listed for the fifth time for compliance of office objections,
there is no representation.
However, to afford final opportunity, list on 19.01.2023."
In spite of that, there is no representation nor complied with the office objections.
It shows that the petitioner is not interested in prosecuting the case.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for default i.e. for non- prosecution.
